new.s: Which ruler is regarded as the greatest king of the Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi?
new.x: Gunaga Vijayaditya III (Tripura Martya Maheshwara) is regarded as the greatest ruler of the line (APHQ 2011). Kubja Vishnuvardhana was the founder, Rajaraja Narendra the patron of Nannaya, and Chalukya Bhima I the builder of the Pancharamas.
new.tq: Founder = Kubja; greatest = Gunaga Vijayaditya III.

new.s: What was the official language of the Eastern Chalukyas, used in most of their about 100 donation inscriptions?
new.x: Sanskrit was the official language, and most of the about 100 donation inscriptions are in Sanskrit. Telugu rose later as a literary language under their patronage; Prakrit and Kannada were not their official language.

new.tq: Kollabhiganda = Chalukya Bhima I; follow the key.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Rajamahendravaram (Rajahmundry):
1. Ammaraja I made it his capital.
2. Rajaraja Narendra ruled from it and beautified it.
3. Jayasimha Vallabha I shifted the capital from Pithapuram to Rajamahendravaram.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: Ammaraja I made Rajamahendravaram his capital and Rajaraja Narendra ruled from it and made it famous (the G2 2008 key says he 'built Rajahmundry'). Statement 3 is wrong: Jayasimha Vallabha I shifted the capital to Vengi. So B; A misses 2, C and D include the false 3.
new.tq: Pithapuram (Kubja) -> Vengi (Jayasimha I) -> Rajamahendravaram (Amma I, RRN).

new.s: Nannaya Bhattaraka, the Adi Kavi of Telugu, was the court poet of
new.x: Nannaya was the court poet of Rajaraja Narendra (1018-1061). Vimaladitya was his father; Chalukya Bhima I patronised Chellavva; Gunaga Vijayaditya III was the greatest warrior king of the line.

new.s: Regarding the Nandampudi inscription, which of the following is correct?
o: Nannaya composed it and Narayana Bhattu received the agrahara
Narayana Bhattu composed it and Nannaya received the agrahara
Pandaranga composed it and Nannaya received the agrahara
Nannaya composed it and Ugradityacharya received the agrahara
new.x: Nannaya composed the Nandampudi inscription, which records the agrahara granted to his collaborator Narayana Bhattu under Rajaraja Narendra. Trap: the APPSC G2 2017 key marked Nannaya as the donee, so know both. Pandaranga is linked to Addanki and Ugradityacharya to Kalyanakaraka.
new.tq: Nandampudi: written by Nannaya, grant to Narayana Bhattu.

new.s: Pavuluri Ganitamu, regarded as the first scientific text in Telugu, is a verse rendering of
new.x: Pavuluri Ganitamu renders Mahaviracharya's Ganitasarasangraham in Telugu verse. Kalyanakaraka is a medical work, Kavijanasrayam a work of Vemulavada Bhimakavi, and Andhra Mahabharatamu the first Telugu literary work.
new.tq: First Telugu science text = Pavuluri Ganitamu (maths).

new.s: Who held the title 'Gandharva-Vidya-Visarada' in the Eastern Chalukya period?
new.x: Chellavva, the court singer and dancer, held the title Gandharva-Vidya-Visarada (APPSC G2 2019). Chamekamba won the Kaluchumbarru grant, Kundavva was Vimaladitya's Chola queen, and Ayyana Mahadevi built the Nedumba Vasati.

new.s: Which of the following were the Shaiva sects prevalent under the Eastern Chalukyas?
new.x: The Shaiva sects of the period were Kapalika, Kalamukha and Pasupata. Pancharatra and Vaikhanasa are Vaishnava traditions, and Virashaiva persecution came later in the Kakatiya age.
